# Rework round 11 claims (personal_loan_servicing)

PLS-R10-1(a) courtesy waiver: closed — the waiver form is a genuine method again: its three tiers are three formula shapes on the unpaid part. A courtesy fewer than 12 whole months before subtracts the keep-back from the unpaid part, never below zero. One 12 to 23 months before takes repeat_courtesy_fraction of the unpaid part. None fewer than 24 months before takes the whole unpaid part, which is the standard. The form reads only the unpaid part (a baseline quantity) and the courtesy history. The courtesy share stays a quantity the computation document defines: courtesy_share_base plus every point, held between zero and one. The amount waived is the form's figure times that share, so every point acts on the standard computation on its own (render item 1 holds). The start-share parameter introduced in round 10 is gone. Task 1's courtesy waiver moves as a result, and all of its proof text was regenerated.
PLS-R10-1(b) AutoPay: closed — the value-picking rate-base factor is replaced by the enrollment rate form, a genuine method over a fixed acting base (the base interest rate less the grade discount and every step, the standard rate). It has three different operations:
- a completed Term Extension Modification takes the modification's record-derived rate reduction off the standard rate, never below the program's floor;
- with no completed modification, an AutoPay debit returned in the last three whole months withholds the steps, leaving only the grade discount;
- otherwise the standard rate applies.
Task 1's enrollment rate is unchanged. Each computation keeps its factor count, at least two parameter factors and one method factor, and every factor still bears weight on its task world.
XF#14 task files: closed — every phrase retired in round 10 ("in the N whole months", "in the last N whole months", "in the whole month", "in person") was regenerated in both task files from the current charter wording, together with every trace, sensitivity, tracing, closure and dossier line that names the changed factors. A mechanical sweep (tier labels, per-factor and all-baseline results, factor sets, trace labels, edge copies, dossier quotes, retired terms) is clean.
render_r1 items 1–7: kept — the rescans (factor-read, isolated-factor, plain-binding, window and convention checks) are clean.
Carried: R10-O1, R9-O1, R8-O1, R4-O1, R3-O1, R2-O3, R2-O4.
